decisions.reason: The net price display plugin fits closely with our shop customization expertise and German B2B ecommerce needs, so our existing knowledge base makes continued refinement and commercialization likely.

An ERP system interface plugin is highly complementary to our end-to-end shop implementation capabilities and creates strong client value, giving us good scope to learn from projects and improve it further.

Price comparison tracking is adjacent to our analytics and performance marketing strengths, so despite some platform dependence we have sufficient absorptive capacity to keep developing and selling it.

This price comparison tracking plugin remains close to our measurable optimization business, and in a growing market we would typically retain such a related extension unless clear weak demand appears.

Although several similar tracking plugins may create some portfolio overlap, the product still builds on our core knowledge in shop analytics and multichannel marketing, which supports keeping it on the market.

The net price reporting plugin complements our analytics and conversion-oriented service model, and our technical and domain expertise should allow us to assimilate user feedback and enhance it commercially.
